title: Correlation-Aware Structured Pruning for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.22131v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Structured pruning is a promising approach for reducing the substantial inference costs of Large Language Models (LLMs) while maintaining hardware efficiency. Many existing methods assess the importance of prunable units (e.g., channels or heads) in isolation, implicitly assuming that pruning errors are additive. This independence assumption is often invalidated by the non-orthogonality of model weights and strong correlations between unit activations, potentially leading to performance degradation. To address this, we propose a Correlation-Aware Structured Pruning method. We formulate the pruning objective as a cardinality-constrained binary quadratic program that explicitly models cross-unit dependencies in the reconstruction error. Since this binary quadratic program is NP-hard and difficult to solve exactly, we develop a greedy interaction algorithm based on dependency-aware marginal costs to optimize unit selection. translated_title: 面向大语言模型的相关性感知结构化剪枝
translated_abstract: 结构化剪枝是一种很有前景的方法，能够在保持硬件效率的同时降低大语言模型（LLM）巨大的推理成本。许多现有方法在评估可剪枝单元（如通道或注意力头）的重要性时是孤立进行的，隐含地假设剪枝误差是可加的。这种独立性假设常常会因模型权重的非正交性以及单元激活之间的强相关性而失效，从而可能导致性能下降。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种相关性感知的结构化剪枝方法。我们将剪枝目标表述为一个基数约束的二元二次规划问题，该问题显式地建模了重建误差中的跨单元依赖关系。由于该二元二次规划问题是NP难的且难以精确求解，我们开发了一种基于依赖感知边际成本的贪心交互算法来优化单元选择。此外，我们……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种相关性感知的结构化剪枝方法，将剪枝建模为显式考虑跨单元依赖关系的二元二次规划问题，并设计基于依赖感知边际成本的贪心交互算法进行求解，从而突破了传统剪枝方法的独立性假设，在降低大语言模型推理成本的同时避免性能下降。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a correlation-aware structured pruning method that formulates pruning as a cardinality-constrained binary quadratic program explicitly modeling cross-unit dependencies, solved by a greedy interaction algorithm based on dependency-aware marginal costs, thereby overcoming the independence assumption of existing pruning methods for LLMs.
